common.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.

errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unauthorized: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
errors.notFound: That could not be found. It may have been deleted.
errors.conflict: That clashes with something that already exists.
errors.server: Something went wrong on the server. Please try again in a moment.
errors.validation: The server did not accept this. Please check the following:
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

validation.email: Enter an email address like name@example.com.
validation.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
validation.identifier: Use letters, digits and underscores only, and start with a letter or an underscore.
validation.url: Enter a full web address that starts with http:// or https://.
validation.range: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}.
validation.duration: Enter zero or a positive number.
validation.durationPositive: Enter a time longer than zero.
validation.maxBelowMin: This has to be at least the minimum number of players.
validation.criteriaOrder: Each step has to start later than the step before it.

login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Manage your games, their leaderboards, items, script events and game modes.
login.failed: That email and password do not match an active account.
login.notActivated: This account is not active yet. Use the code from the activation email first.
login.sessionExpired: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
login.activated: Your account is active. You can sign in now.
login.passwordReset: Your password has been changed. Sign in with the new one.

register.title: Create an account
register.intro: Register as a developer to create games and get the keys your games need.
register.doneBody: We sent an activation code to {email}. Follow the link in that email, or enter the code on the activation page.

activate.title: Activate your account
activate.intro: Enter the email you registered with and the code we sent to it.
activate.doneBody: Thanks for confirming your email. You can sign in now.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.intro: Enter your email and we will send you a code for choosing a new password.
forgot.doneBody: If there is an account for {email}, we just sent it a code for resetting the password.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.intro: Enter the code from the email and pick a new password.

games.title: Games
games.intro: Every game has its own key. A game connects with its game key and your developer key.
games.empty: You have no games yet. Create one to get the keys for the SDK.
games.createdNotice: {name} is ready. These are the values the game needs.
games.deleteBody: Game clients will no longer be able to connect to this game. This cannot be undone.

fields.name: Name
fields.platformHint: For example Android, iOS or Windows.

credentials.title: Keys for {name}
credentials.intro: Put these values in the WildCat settings of your game project.
credentials.secretHint: The secret belongs to your account and is the same for all your games. Treat it like a password and keep it out of public code.
credentials.regenerateBody: The current secret stops working right away, for every game and tool that uses it.
credentials.regenerated: The secret has been replaced. Update any game or tool that used the old one.

leaderboards.intro: Leaderboards rank players by score. Games submit scores to a leaderboard by its name.
leaderboards.empty: This game has no leaderboards yet.

fields.name: Name
fields.nameHint: Your game uses this name to submit and read scores.
fields.scoreRule: Which score to keep for each player
fields.bestHint: A new score only counts when it beats the player's current one.
fields.latestHint: Every new score replaces the player's current one.

leaderboards.deleteBody: All scores on it will be lost. This cannot be undone.

items.intro: Items are the virtual goods players can own, such as currencies, power-ups or keys.
items.empty: This game has no items yet.
items.deleteBody: Anything that refers to this item, such as the price of another item, will no longer find it. This cannot be undone.

fields.name: Name
fields.nameFixed: The name is the item's id and cannot be changed.
fields.stackableHint: Several of this item share one inventory slot.
fields.isConsumableHint: The item is used up when a player uses it.
fields.automaticallyConsumedHint: Consumed as soon as a player receives it.
fields.effectTimeHint: How long the effect of using the item lasts. Leave at 0 for items without a timed effect.
fields.isRegeneratingHint: Players get more of it back on a schedule, like lives or energy.
fields.metaDataHint: Extra name and value pairs your game reads, such as a sprite name or a color.
fields.priceHint: What a player pays for one of this item, in other items. Leave empty for a free item.

events.intro: Script events are C# methods that run on the server when a game triggers them by name.
events.empty: This game has no script events yet.

fields.name: Event name
fields.nameHint: The name games call the event by. It is also the name of the method in the script.
fields.nameFixed: The name cannot be changed. Create a new event to use another name.
fields.parametersHint: The values a game sends with the event, in order.

events.signatureHint: The script needs a method with this name and these parameters. Return Task<T> instead of Task to send a value back to the game. The WildCat object gives access to the server.
events.editorKeyboardHint: In the editor, Tab indents. To move on with the keyboard, press Escape and then Tab.
events.saved: Saved. The script passed the server checks.
events.deleteBody: Games that trigger this event will no longer run any script. This cannot be undone.
events.leaveBody: Your changes to this event have not been saved.

gameModes.intro: Game modes control matchmaking: how many players a match needs and how picky the matching is while players wait.
gameModes.empty: This game has no game modes yet.
gameModes.deleteBody: Games can no longer start matchmaking in this mode. This cannot be undone.

fields.name: Name
fields.nameHint: Games ask for matchmaking in a mode by this name.
fields.firstStepHint: The first step always starts right away.
fields.minPlayersEnough: Start with the minimum number of players

gameModes.criteriaHint: The longer a player waits, the less picky matching gets. Each step applies from its start time until the next step begins.

publisherData.title: Publisher data
publisherData.intro: Values shared by all your games, such as settings or announcements. Games can read them by key; only you can change them.
publisherData.empty: You have not stored any values yet.

fields.keyHint: Games read the value by this key.

publisherData.deleteBody: Games that read this key will get nothing back. This cannot be undone.

developers.title: Developers
developers.intro: Everyone who has registered as a developer.

account.title: Account
account.passwordRejected: The current password is not correct.

noPermission.title: No access
noPermission.body: Your account does not have permission to see this page.

notFound.title: Nothing here
notFound.body: There is no page at this address. It may have moved or been deleted.

crash.title: Something broke
crash.body: The panel ran into an unexpected problem. Reloading usually helps.
